text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
While waiting for the bus back to the 
academy, I walked over to Air Messiah's 
side.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The person she was talking with... was 
almost certainly the Umamusume with the 
blue hairpin. Their bond had grown much 
closer over the summer.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, to tell the truth... in yesterday's 
daily report, they attached a design 
concept for a racing outfit.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
"She said, 'It might be getting ahead of 
myself, but this is also a declaration of 
my resolve to definitely run in a GⅠ race 
one day!'"
choice_data_list:
I can really feel your fighting spirit, 
and I like it.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Yes. It's heartwarming, but even more than 
that... her will to win brings me great 
joy.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Even so, what a lovely design. Fufu... 
Could this flower be matching with me, by 
any chance?
choice_data_list:
By the way... your messages are 'daily 
reports'?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Curiosity getting the better of me, I ask. 
Seeing as they'd exchanged LANE info, I 
assumed their messages would be a lot more 
casual.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
"This is probably the way that suits me 
best, after all—"

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
"Even so, that is more than enough to 
forge a bond. Or so I believe. ...For I 
know this well."

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Ah... Looks like the bus has arrived. 
Shall we head back to the academy, 
Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Nodding, I begin to walk alongside Air 
Messiah. Step by step.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Heading toward the battle to crown the 
autumn queen. There, she will... show them 
all.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Steady, certain steps will bring about the 
victory that must be won.
